content: Kate suggested getting an appraisal for the house so we can find out how much it will sell for. My immediate thought was "that's a good idea but I wouldn't want to waste someone's time when we won't be selling for a while" but I caught myself halfway and realized that selling was what I wanted so actually "yes that's a great idea". I'm slowly learning to fight my urges for stability so I can do the things that bring me happiness. She wanted to do a garage sale too. Another good idea but I didn't think hard enough on that one. It's just so tedious and of little actual value, but directionally another very good idea.
